package.name: g29_control
package.description: Logitech G29 steering wheel/pedal manual control of a CARLA ego vehicle, plus an optional CSV route logger. Maps standard sensor_msgs/Joy reports (from the ROS 2 joy package) to carla_msgs/CarlaEgoVehicleControl. Extracted from PathPlanningWS's cacc_carla_bringup package, with the CACC-specific dependencies removed. No force-feedback is configured here; FFB relies on the kernel HID driver's defaults.
